text_en: But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of God, and no torment will ever touch them.
text_cn: 义人的灵魂在天主手里，痛苦不能伤害他们。

text_en: In the eyes of the foolish they seemed to have died, and their departure was thought to be a disaster,
text_cn: 在愚人看来，他们算是死了，认为他们去世是受了惩罚，

text_en: and their going from us to be their destruction; but they are at peace.
text_cn: 离我们而去，仿佛是归于泯灭；其实，他们是处于安宁中；

text_en: For though in the sight of others they were punished, their hope is full of immortality.
text_cn: 虽然在人看来，他们是受了苦；其实，却充满着永生的希望。

text_en: Having been disciplined a little, they will receive great good, because God tested them and found them worthy of himself;
text_cn: 他们受了些许的痛苦，却要蒙受绝大的恩惠，因为天主试验了他们，发觉他们配作自己的人：

text_en: like gold in the furnace he tried them, and like a sacrificial burnt offering he accepted them.
text_cn: 他试炼了他们，好像炉中的黄金；悦纳了他们，有如悦纳全燔祭。

text_en: In the time of their visitation they will shine forth, and will run like sparks through the stubble.
text_cn: 他们蒙眷顾时，必要闪烁发光，有如禾秸（jiē）间往来飞驰的火花。

text_en: They will govern nations and rule over peoples, and the Lord will reign over them forever.
text_cn: 他们要审判万国，统治万民，上主要永远作他们的君王。

text_en: Those who trust in him will understand truth, and the faithful will abide with him in love, because grace and mercy are upon his holy ones, and he watches over his elect.
text_cn: 倚恃（shì）上主的人，必明白真理；忠信于上主之爱的人，必与他同住，因为恩泽与仁慈，原归于他所选拔的人。

text_en: But the ungodly will be punished as their reasoning deserves, those who disregarded the righteous and rebelled against the Lord;
text_cn: 但是不虔敬的人，必因他们的思念而遭受惩罚，因为他们蔑视了义人，离弃了上主。

text_en: for those who despise wisdom and instruction are miserable. Their hope is vain, their labors are unprofitable, and their works are useless.
text_cn: 轻视智慧和教训的人是有祸的：他们的希望只有落空，劳苦只有徒劳，工作只有失败；

text_en: Their wives are foolish, and their children evil;
text_cn: 他们的妻子愚蠢，子女邪恶，后裔可咒骂。

text_en: their offspring are accursed. For blessed is the barren woman who is undefiled, who has not entered into a sinful union; she will have fruit when God examines souls.
text_cn: 荒胎无罪，而又不知床笫（zǐ）罪恶的妇女，是有福的；到灵魂受眷顾的时候，她必富有果实。

text_en: Blessed also is the eunuch whose hands have done no lawless deed, and who has not devised wicked things against the Lord; for special favor will be shown him for his faithfulness, and a place of great delight in the temple of the Lord.
text_cn: 同样，不生育的男人，手若不作非法的行为，心不思念相反上主的恶事，是有福的；天主见他忠贞，必赐给他特赏，在上主的圣殿中，赐给他更称心的一份。

text_en: For the fruit of good labors is renowned, and the root of understanding does not fail.
text_cn: 因为高尚的劳苦必结荣誉的果实，智慧的根蒂绝不会中断。

text_en: But children of adulterers will not come to maturity, and the offspring of an unlawful union will perish.
text_cn: 淫乱的儿子长不到成年，苟合而生的子孙必将灭绝。

text_en: Even if they live long they will be held of no account, and finally their old age will be without honor.
text_cn: 他们纵使长命，也不值一文；就是到了高年，也无人尊敬；

text_en: If they die young, they will have no hope and no consolation on the day of judgment.
text_cn: 假若他们早死，也没有什么希望，在审判之日，也没有安慰。

text_en: For the end of an unrighteous generation is grievous.
text_cn: 恶人后裔的结局实在悲惨。
